records.en: While they are, perhaps, not central to meaning in communication in the same way as grammar or vocabulary, they may, nevertheless, convey attitude or intention in some way.
zh: 虽然它们可能不像语法或词汇那样处于交流意义的核心，
却仍然能够在某种程度上传达态度或意图。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: The expression on our face, the gestures we make and even proximity or way we sit, are some of the ways we send powerful messages about how we feel, or what we mean.
zh: 面部表情、手势，甚至我们与别人之间的距离或坐姿，
都能有力地传达自己的感受或意思。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Other facial actions, such as biting your lip, which indicates that you are deep in thinking, or are uncertain about something; compressing the lips, which show that you are making decisions; and a visible clenching of the teeth, to show that you are angry, are all powerful conveyers of meaning, too.
zh: 其他面部动作，比如咬嘴唇，表示你在深思或对某事拿不准；
抿紧嘴唇表示你在作决定；
明显地咬紧牙齿，则表示你很生气。这些动作也都能有力地传达意义。
records.old_whole_zh: 其他面部动作也能有力地传达意义：比如，咬嘴唇表示你在深思或对某事拿不准；抿紧嘴唇表示你在作决定；明显地咬紧牙齿，则表示你很生气。
records.decision: 原候选把compressing the lips放在第一英文屏而中文在第二屏，且整句归纳义在中文提前。改为按三种动作三屏，中文保义调序：归纳义放在对应末尾conveyers of meaning所在屏。

records.en: And standing close to someone may be quite appropriate in some situations such as an informal party, but completely out of place in other situations, such as a meeting with a superior.
zh: 站得离别人很近，在非正式聚会等场合可能很合适，
但在与上级开会等场合，就可能完全不妥。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: These features, together with linguistic features of language, like grammar, or vocabulary, are all part of the way we communicate with each other in face to face encounters.
zh: 这些特征，与语法、词汇等语言特征一起，
都构成了面对面交流方式的一部分。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: In our next lecture, we’ll watch some video material, and see how people actually use paralinguistic means in communication to express their intention or desire or mood.
zh: 下一堂课，我们会看一些视频材料，
了解人们在交流中如何实际运用副语言手段，来表达意图、愿望或情绪。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: It seems to me that nowadays Americans cannot turn on the television or read a newspaper without seeing the word pop up somewhere as a description of the American demographic.
zh: 在我看来，如今美国人只要打开电视或翻开报纸，
就会在某处看到这个词，用来描述美国的人口构成。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Well, at one time the US was called a melting pot, you know, which means that people of many different religions, cultures, and races could shed their traditional cultural identities and blend into one homogeneous nation.
records.at: could shed their traditional cultural identities
zh: 嗯，美国曾被称为“大熔炉”，也就是说，信仰、文化和种族各不相同的人，
可以放下原有的传统文化身份，融合为一个同质的国家。
records.decision: 将边界从religions与cultures之间移至could shed之前，第一屏完整列出宗教/文化/种族，第二屏对应放下身份与融合。

records.en: Um, of course, when the phrase “melting pot” was popular, there was also the idea of being different, but being different then simply meant Catholic as opposed to Protestant, or Irish as opposed to Swedish or Italian.
zh: 嗯，当然，在“大熔炉”这个说法流行时，也存在差异的观念，
不过那时所谓的不同，只是天主教徒相对于新教徒，或者爱尔兰裔相对于瑞典裔、意大利裔的差别。
records.decision: 中文不过那时所谓的不同移至but being different then所在第二屏，全文未变。

records.en: You see today, we use the word diversity to refer to more-visible ethnic differences — Asian American, African American, and Latino, for instance.
zh: 你看，如今我们用“多样性”指更为明显的族裔差异，
例如亚裔美国人、非裔美国人以及拉丁裔。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Well, I think in all this talk of diversity there is a critical point that may be missed: that is, diversity is not occurring everywhere in the US, or at least not to a degree that would alter the demography of every region in the country.
zh: 嗯，我认为，在所有这些关于多样性的讨论中，人们可能忽略了一个关键点：
多样化并未发生在美国所有地方，至少还没有达到改变全国每个地区人口构成的程度。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: On the contrary, Maine’s Caucasian population was 98% of its total population throughout the 1990s; and by 2025, Maine’s population will still be 97% Caucasian, which means virtually no change in Maine’s racial diversity over the next 20 or so years.
zh: 相反，整个20世纪90年代，缅因州的高加索裔人口占总人口的98%；到2025年，
这个比例仍将为97%，也就是说，在之后二十年左右的时间里，缅因州的种族多样性几乎不会发生变化。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: So this could lead to a future where wealth is systematically redistributed from younger, poorer minorities to older, wealthier whites.
zh: 因此，今后可能会出现这样的局面：财富通过制度性的再分配，从较年轻、较贫穷的少数族裔群体，
流向较年长、较富裕的白人。
records.decision: 按明确原音改字重锚whites。原候选在younger/poorer minorities中间切导致族群译义提前；移至to older之前，保留当前白人中文。

reanchor.old_en: So this could lead to a future where wealth is systematically redistributed from younger, poorer minorities to older, wealthier ones.
reanchor.new_en: So this could lead to a future where wealth is systematically redistributed from younger, poorer minorities to older, wealthier whites.

records.en: So we see that many parts of the US are truly becoming more diverse while at the same time others are essentially remaining the same in terms of race, age and religion.
zh: 所以我们可以看到，美国的许多地方确实正在变得更多元；
与此同时，另一些地方在种族、年龄和宗教方面基本保持不变。
records.decision: 原候选末屏只有age and religion，中文却含完整对照分句。改在while处切开两类地区的对照。

records.en: However, it’s possible that people from different cultures have different assumptions about the world, regarding such important and basic ideas as time, personal space.
zh: 然而，来自不同文化的人，对于世界可能有不同的基本认识，
其中就涉及时间、私人空间等重要而基础的观念。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: And Edward Hall is an anthropologist who spent a large part of his life studying American Indians, their culture, their language, but he was different from a lot of other anthropologists who just study one culture.
zh: 爱德华·霍尔是一位人类学家，他一生中的很大一部分时间都在研究美洲印第安人及其文化和语言，
但他与许多只研究单一文化的人类学家不同。
records.decision: 原候选把their language放第二英文屏，中文语言在第一屏；移至but he was different，使研究对象/对照各完整一屏。

records.en: First in terms of personal space, generally speaking, in a high-context culture, because there’s greater dependency on group thinking, people lean towards heavier sensory involvement or closeness to people.
zh: 首先来看私人空间。一般来说，在高语境文化中，
由于人们更依赖群体思维，他们倾向于更多的感官接触，或与他人保持更近的距离。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Because remember what I said, the definition of a high-context culture is that more attention is paid to the context of the message than to the message itself, and part of the context is body language.
zh: 因为，请记住我刚才说过的定义：高语境文化更关注信息的语境，而不是信息本身；
身体语言也是语境的一部分。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: A low-context culture is one in which the message, the event or the action is a separate entity, having meaning unto itself, regardless of the surroundings or the context.
zh: 在低语境文化中，信息、事件或行为是独立的实体，
自身就具有意义，不依赖周围的情境或语境。
records.decision: 按明确onto→unto裁决更新过期at，独立实体与其自身含义/语境各一屏；词注separate entity及regardless of各覆盖对应屏。

reanchor.old_en: A low-context culture is one in which the message, the event or the action is a separate entity, having meaning onto itself, regardless of the surroundings or the context.
reanchor.new_en: A low-context culture is one in which the message, the event or the action is a separate entity, having meaning unto itself, regardless of the surroundings or the context.

records.en: There’s more emphasis on individuality, so the concept of privacy is very very important, whereas before as I said, in a high-context culture they might not even be concerned with privacy or personal space.
zh: 这里更强调个体性，所以隐私的观念非常、非常重要；
而正如我前面所说，在高语境文化中，人们可能甚至不太在意隐私或私人空间。
records.decision: 按or as→whereas裁决重锚；将对照引导语与中文而正如置于第二屏，不跨屏预告。

reanchor.old_en: There’s more emphasis on individuality, so the concept of privacy is very very important, or as before as I said, in a high-context culture they might not even be concerned with privacy or personal space.
reanchor.new_en: There’s more emphasis on individuality, so the concept of privacy is very very important, whereas before as I said, in a high-context culture they might not even be concerned with privacy or personal space.

records.en: There’s a respect and a desire for privacy, and you also see that people might pay less attention to body language because as I said the message is, the message is everything.
zh: 人们尊重并且渴望拥有隐私；
你也会发现，他们可能不太关注身体语言，因为正如我所说，信息才是……信息才是一切。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: People in a low-context culture will be much more upset with lateness because they feel that everyone should follow the same time; there shouldn’t be all this flexibility with time and they expect punctuality.
zh: 低语境文化中的人会更难以接受迟到，因为他们认为，每个人都应遵守同一套时间，
不应当对时间有这么大的弹性，而且他们要求准时。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

reanchor.old_en: People in a low-context culture would be much more upset with lateness because they feel that everyone should follow the same time; there shouldn’t be all this flexibility with time and they expect punctuality.
reanchor.new_en: People in a low-context culture will be much more upset with lateness because they feel that everyone should follow the same time; there shouldn’t be all this flexibility with time and they expect punctuality.

records.en: And he thinks that this has all kinds of relevance no matter what you’re doing, if you’re in business, negotiations, interpersonal relations, if you’re dealing with people from different cultures in any way, it’s going to affect every part of your life.
zh: 他认为，无论你从事什么，这些差异都与你密切相关：无论是商业活动、谈判，
还是人际交往，只要你以任何方式与来自不同文化的人打交道，它就会影响你生活的各个方面。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Now, Dr. Harley. Since learning a second language is a difficult process, you know, in one way or another, are there any methods, so far, effective methods to teach a second language?
zh: 那么，哈利博士，既然学习第二语言是一个艰难的过程，
或多或少都会遇到困难，那么到目前为止，有没有什么方法，有效的方法，来教授第二语言？
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: According to Krashen, children acquire their first language largely unconsciously and automatically, but adults could only learn a second language consciously and effortfully.
zh: 克拉申认为，儿童主要是在无意识、自然而然的过程中习得母语，
而成年人只能有意识地、付出努力地学习第二语言。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: For instance, when we observe casually, we may not be aware of factors that bias our observations, and, and when we rarely keep formal records of our observations.
zh: 例如，随意观察时，我们可能意识不到哪些因素使观察结果产生偏差，
而且我们很少正式记录观察结果。
records.decision: 保留已审当前中文产生偏差，防止旧候选带有偏见覆盖当前正文；两分句对应。

records.en: Observations in research on the other hand are made under precisely defined conditions, that is, in a systematic and objective manner, and with careful record keeping.
zh: 而研究中的观察是在明确规定的条件下开展的，
也就是说，要采用系统、客观的方式，并认真做好记录。
records.decision: that is位于第二英文屏，也就是说随其移到第二中文屏，全文不变。

records.en: Then how are we going to conduct observations in our research studies, and what do we need to do in order to make a scientific and objective observation?
zh: 那么，在研究中应该如何进行观察？
要做到科学、客观，我们又需要做些什么？
records.decision: 原第一中文屏只有那么而英文已问如何研究观察；按两个真实问句分配中文，全文不变。

records.en: Now, as you remember, the primary goal of observation is to describe behaviour, but it is in reality impossible to observe and describe all of a person’s behaviour.
zh: 大家还记得，观察的首要目标是描述行为，
但实际上，我们不可能观察并描述一个人的所有行为。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: By sampling as many different situations as possible researchers can reduce the chance that their observation results will be peculiar to a certain set of circumstances and conditions.
zh: 尽可能对多种情境取样，
能够降低观察结果只适用于某组特定情形和条件的可能性。
records.decision: 原cut割裂as many...as possible且中文尽可能提前；在researchers处切，第一屏完整抽样方式，第二屏完整研究结果。

records.en: For example, children do not always behave the same way with one parent as they do with the other parent, and animals do not behave the same way in zoos as they do in the wild.
zh: 例如，孩子面对父母中的一方时，表现不一定与面对另一方时相同；
动物在动物园里的行为，也和在野外不同。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Having discussed ways to sample behaviour in research, we are now moving onto another issue, that is, what researchers should do to record behaviour as it occurs, that is whether researchers are active or passive in recording behaviour.
zh: 讨论完研究中如何进行行为取样后，我们接下来转向另一个问题：
研究人员应如何实时记录行为，也就是他们在记录时是主动介入还是被动观察。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: In participant observation, observers, that is researchers, play a dual role: They observe people’s behaviour and they participate actively in the situation they are observing.
zh: 在参与式观察中，观察者，也就是研究人员，承担双重角色：
既观察人们的行为，也积极参与所观察的情境。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: If individuals who are being observed know that the observer is present to collect information about their behaviour, this is undisguised participant observation.
zh: 如果被观察者知道，观察者在场是为了收集他们的行为信息，
这就属于公开的参与式观察。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: When an observer controls one or more conditions in a natural setting in order to determine their effect on behaviour, this procedure is called field experiment.
zh: 观察者在自然环境中控制一个或多个条件，以确定这些条件对行为的影响，
这种研究程序就叫实地实验。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

reanchor.old_en: When an observer controls one or more conditions in a natural setting in order to determine the effect on behaviour, this procedure is called field experiment.
reanchor.new_en: When an observer controls one or more conditions in a natural setting in order to determine their effect on behaviour, this procedure is called field experiment.

records.en: Observation without intervention is also called naturalistic observation because its main purpose is to describe behaviour as it normally occurs, that is, in a natural setting, without any attempt by the observer to intervene.
zh: 无干预观察也叫自然观察，因为它主要用于描述行为自然发生时的样子，
也就是在自然环境中观察，而观察者不作任何干预。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: But the end result is invariably the production of something new and useful, such as the automobile, or something beautiful and artistic, such as a painting by Vincent van Gogh.
zh: 但最终结果总是创造出某种新颖实用的东西，比如汽车；
或者某种优美、具有艺术性的东西，比如文森特·梵高的画。
records.decision: 原候选such as the automobile在第二英文屏而中文汽车在第一屏；移至or something beautiful，使新颖实用/汽车和艺术优美/梵高各自对应。

records.en: Well, no one knows yet if the ability to be creative, for example, the ability to produce a haunting symphony is the result of the environment or a genetic makeup that allows people to be creative more easily.
zh: 目前还没有人知道，创造能力——
比如创作出令人难忘的交响曲的能力——究竟来自环境，还是来自使人更容易产生创造力的遗传构成。
records.decision: for example与交响曲的中文解释同置第二屏，第一屏创造能力总述完整。

records.en: Yes. You see, Johann Sebastian Bach was the most famous member of the Bach family, but there were 20 other eminent musicians who came from the same family.
zh: 是的。约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫是巴赫家族最著名的成员，
但这个家族还出了二十位杰出的音乐家。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: For example, you know writers can spend hours at the keyboard putting thoughts together—this process is similar to the way people put together novel ideas when talking.
zh: 例如，作家会花好几个小时坐在键盘前组织想法；
这个过程，类似于人们交谈时把新想法组织起来。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Well, for the moment no one knows for sure, but but research suggests that creative people often slip into a zone in which ideas, uh, and thoughts come up freely in a sort of disorganized way.
zh: 目前还没有人确切知道，但研究表明，有创造力的人常常会进入一种状态，
想法和念头会以一种不太有条理的方式自由涌现。
records.decision: 保留research suggests已审中文研究表明；在in which ideas前切，想法不在英文第一屏/中文第二屏错配。

reanchor.old_en: Well, for the moment no one knows for sure, but but researchers suggest that creative people often slip into a zone in which ideas, uh, and thoughts come up freely in a sort of disorganized way.
reanchor.new_en: Well, for the moment no one knows for sure, but but research suggests that creative people often slip into a zone in which ideas, uh, and thoughts come up freely in a sort of disorganized way.

records.en: Both men in fact came from families that didn’t especially value creativity, yet someone noticed a spark of talent in them and both got the training and financial backing to produce extraordinary pieces of art.
zh: 实际上，两人都来自并不特别重视创造力的家庭，
但有人发现了他们显露出的才华，他们也都获得了培训和资金支持，从而创作出杰出的艺术作品。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: In order to define active learning, I will look at the differences between active learning and passive learning by examining six characteristics of active learners and contrasting them with those of passive learners.
zh: 为了给主动学习下定义，我会考察主动学习和被动学习的区别，
方法是考察主动学习者的六个特点，并将它们与被动学习者的特点作比较。
records.old_whole_zh: 为了给主动学习下定义，我会考察主动学习者的六个特点，并将它们与被动学习者的特点作比较，从而说明主动学习和被动学习的区别。
records.decision: 原中文把第二英文屏six characteristics先提到第一屏，再把第一英文屏difference放第二屏；保义调序，按总目标/考察方法顺序翻译。

records.en: However, I am sure that some of you have been in a situation, probably more than once, where you read — quote and unquote — an assignment, closed the text and thought “what the world was that about?”
zh: 不过，我确信你们中有些人可能不止一次遇到过这种情况：
所谓“读过了”布置的阅读材料，合上书，却在想：“刚才那到底讲了些什么？”
records.decision: 原候选在read之后切却把所谓读过了全放第二中文屏；改在where you read前，情境引入与实际读后茫然各屏对应。

records.en: For instance, you may make connections between the new information and what you already know, identify concepts that you may not understand very well or evaluate the importance of what you are reading.
zh: 例如，你可以把新信息与已有知识联系起来，
找出自己可能不太理解的概念，或者评估所读内容的重要性。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: In contrast, passive learners may read the text and listen to lectures and even understand most of what is read and heard, but they do not take that crucial next step of actually thinking about it.
zh: 相比之下，被动学习者可能也读文章、听讲座，甚至理解大部分读到和听到的内容，
但他们没有迈出至关重要的下一步：真正思考这些内容。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Because active learners are constantly monitoring their understanding, they know when their comprehension breaks down, and they ask for help before they become lost.
zh: 因为主动学习者一直在检查自己的理解情况，
所以他们知道自己何时出现理解障碍，并会在完全跟不上之前求助。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Active learners may seek assistance from their professors or peers, although passive learners may seek help at some point, it is often too little, too late.
zh: 主动学习者可能会向老师或同学求助；
被动学习者虽然也可能在某个时候求助，但往往已经为时过晚，所获帮助也不足以解决问题。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: This means that active learners raise questions on information that they read and hear, while passive learners accept both the printed page and the words of their professors as truth.
zh: 这意味着，主动学习者会对读到和听到的信息提出问题，
而被动学习者则把书面材料和老师的话都当作真理接受。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Active learners understand that the responsibility for learning must come from within, while passive learners often want to blame others for their lack of motivation, poor performance, time management problems and other difficulties that they might experience.
zh: 主动学习者明白，学习的责任必须由自己承担；
而被动学习者则往往想把问题归咎于别人：
自己缺乏动力、表现不佳、时间管理混乱，以及可能遇到的其他困难。
records.old_whole_zh: 主动学习者明白，学习的责任必须由自己承担；而被动学习者则往往想把自己缺乏动力、表现不佳、时间管理混乱及遇到的其他困难归咎于别人。
records.decision: 原候选把被动学习者归咎他人提前在第一英文屏而中文在第二屏。两屏语义修正后第二屏几何太长，现按责任承担/归咎他人/所列问题三屏；中文仅保义改为冒号总分句，避免动词推迟到最后一屏或语义重复。真实词首切屏保留原音，绝不接受工具机械复原旧错屏cut。

records.en: When active learners don’t perform as well as they’d hoped, they evaluate why they didn’t do well and change those studying behaviors the next time.
zh: 当主动学习者表现没有达到预期时，
他们会分析原因，并在下一次改变相应的学习行为。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

他虽然阅读广泛，也能有见地地讨论各种问题，却很少做功课，也很少学习。

records.en: OK, today we’ve discussed the differences between an active learner and a passive one, and some useful study strategies that may eventually help you become an active learner.

records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: I think what’s striking about the results is that by far workers valued important and meaningful work as more important than any of the other characteristics, that included salary.

其中也包括工资。

records.en: Yeah. Now I’m going to tell you about another poll, and this poll was taken a year later in 1991, and it asked the respondents to reflect on how important certain job characteristics were in their work.
zh: 下面再介绍另一项调查。这项调查在一年后，也就是一九九一年开展，

records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: And this is a different type of poll because whereas in the first poll, respondents had to choose only one out of five, in this poll they wanted the respondents to react to each item separately.

records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Then in the 1930s, a doctor named Hans Selye, S-e-l-y-e, first used this term to describe a human’s reaction to a demand placed on it, pleasant or not.
zh: 到了二十世纪三十年代，一位名叫汉斯·塞利的医生——姓氏拼作S-e-l-y-e——
首次用这个术语描述人对外界要求所作出的反应，无论这种要求令人愉快与否。
records.decision: 姓名拼读已在第一英文屏，中文同放第一屏；第二屏从first used开始，全文不变。

records.en: So psychologists have found that if we develop appropriate ways to cope with stressful situations, individuals can reduce the physiological harm which is caused by stress, or which can be caused by stress.
zh: 心理学家因此发现，如果我们学会以适当的方式应对压力情境，
就能够减轻压力已经造成或可能造成的生理伤害。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: We all have different types of stress signals, but individuals should monitor themselves for stress signals so that they can focus on minimizing or acknowledging the stress before it gets out of control.
zh: 每个人的压力信号各不相同，但我们都应该留意自身的这些信号，
以便在压力失控之前，着手减轻它，或者正视它的存在。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: You can consider ways to protect yourself when you start seeing these signs coming on, so you might decide to withdraw from a stressful situation or reward yourself with equal amounts of low stress activity time.
zh: 开始察觉这些迹象时，就可以考虑如何保护自己。
比如，选择暂时离开压力情境，或者奖励自己等量时间，去参加压力较小的活动。
records.decision: 中文比如移至so you might decide所举方案第二屏，全文不变。

还能让身体忙起来，专注于不会造成压力的事情。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: You can make plans and act when it’s appropriate, but when it’s not appropriate or when it’s impossible, the only way is to learn to accept that some things are unchangeable, and out of your hands.

唯一的办法就是学会接受：有些事是改变不了、也不由你掌控的。

records.en: They are refugees and this trip is to get a better picture of the internally displaced people and to discuss the situation with the local government, with our government, with the NGOs and with local people and try to understand what is happening,
zh: 他们是难民；这次访问是为了更全面地了解境内流离失所者的情况，
与当地政府、我国政府、非政府组织以及当地民众讨论现状，努力弄清楚正在发生什么。
records.decision: 原cut使local government在第一英文屏而中文当地政府在第二屏；改在讨论情形前，访问目的之一/与各方讨论目的各对应。

records.en: because there are over 2 million internally displaced people and there doesn’t seem to be a real coherent plan to help them and there’s lots of good will and lots of discussion — but just a lot of talk at the moment and a lot of pieces need to be put together.
records.at: and there’s lots of good will
zh: 因为境内流离失所者超过两百万人，但似乎还没有一个真正协调一致的援助计划。
虽然有很多善意，也有很多讨论，但目前还多停留在口头上，许多环节仍需要整合。
records.decision: 将中文善意移至there’s lots of good will所在第二屏，并避免把连接词and留第一屏。全文不变。

records.en: Well, I in my research before I came here, I looked at the numbers and there are over 4 million people displaced and of the 2 million internally displaced it’s estimated that 58 percent are under 12 years old.
zh: 来之前做调查时，我看了相关数字：流离失所的人超过四百万；而在其中两百万境内流离失所者中，
估计有百分之五十八是十二岁以下的儿童。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: So far the different officials I’ve met with and different local people I’ve met with all have shared concerns and very strongly, you know, they have spoken out about the humanitarian crisis but um, there seems to be a block in.
zh: 到目前为止，我会见的不同官员和当地民众都有共同的担忧，
也都强烈呼吁关注这场人道主义危机；但是，事情似乎卡在了某个环节。
records.decision: 将very strongly与第二屏spoken out连在一起，对应中文也都强烈呼吁，避免强烈跨屏。

records.en: Well, I don’t have the answers but I know that this is one thing that needs to be addressed and solved because there does need to be a real presence here to help count the people and register the people.
zh: 我没有现成的答案，但我知道这是必须处理和解决的问题之一，
因为这里确实需要有机构实实在在地开展工作，帮助统计人数，并为这些人登记。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: And I think it’s in our best interest to address a humanitarian crisis on this scale because displacement can lead to a lot of instability and aggression.
zh: 而且，解决如此大规模的人道主义危机，也最符合我们自身的利益，
因为人口流离失所可能引发严重的动荡和攻击行为。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: But if these communities don’t start coming back together properly, if we don’t start really counting the people... understanding where they are... what they need...
zh: 但如果这些社区没有开始妥善地重新凝聚起来，
如果我们没有真正开始统计人数，了解他们在哪里、需要什么……
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: What would be the message that you would want to carry out of here back home or even the message that you would want to get out internationally in terms of what’s happening here... the refugee crisis... the consequences that could happen in the future if it’s not properly addressed?
zh: 您希望从这里带回国内怎样的信息，
或者说，向国际社会传递怎样的信息，内容涉及这里正在发生的事情、这场难民危机，
以及如果处理不当将来可能带来的后果？
records.old_whole_zh: 关于这里正在发生的事情、这场难民危机，以及如果处理不当将来可能带来的后果，您希望向国内乃至国际社会传递怎样的信息？
records.decision: 原候选无合法自动方案；整句中文原为话题前置，按英文问句真实顺序保义调序成国内信息/国际信息及现状危机/未来后果三屏。无英文或时间改动。

records.en: Um but I think it’s clear that a displaced unstable population is what happens in Iraq, and how Iraq settles in the years to come is going to affect the entire Middle East.
zh: 但我认为很清楚，伊拉克目前存在着大量流离失所、生活不稳定的人口；
而伊拉克在未来几年如何安定下来，将影响整个中东。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: And a big part of what is going to affect how it settles is how these people are returned and settled into their homes into their community and brought back together
records.at: is how these people are returned
zh: 影响伊拉克如何安定下来的一个重要因素，
就是这些人将如何返回、如何在家园和社区安顿下来并重新聚在一起。
records.decision: 原cut在returned和settled之间，中文把返回延迟到第二屏。移至is how，第一屏影响安定的重要因素，第二屏完整返回/安置/重聚。

records.en: so today I’m able to talk to all different people from our government and their government and really get some answers as to what is holding up the processes to really assist these people properly.
zh: 所以，今天我能与我国政府和伊拉克政府的不同人员交谈，
真正弄清楚：究竟是什么拖延了程序，使这些人迟迟得不到妥善援助。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: You know there are many different people who can be cynical or say well how are they going to do it, and I will ask them how are you going to do it and is there some way we can help to... you know.
zh: 有些人可能会冷嘲热讽，或者说：“他们打算怎么做到呢？”
而我会直接问他们：“你们打算怎么做到？我们有没有办法帮忙……”
records.decision: 而我会直接问他们属于第二英文屏and I will ask them，移动中文边界，全文不变。

records.en: Now, at the university, you, as students, are often called on to perform many types of listening tasks: listening in a group discussion, listening to a teacher on a one-to-one basis, and listening to academic lectures.
zh: 在大学里，作为学生，你们经常需要完成各种听力任务：
听小组讨论、与老师一对一交谈，以及听学术讲座。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: So the meaning is not in the word alone, rather it is in the person who uses it or responds to it so that the second thing that a listener must do— add information that the lecturer assumes that they share.
zh: 因此，意义并不只存在于词语本身，也存在于使用这些词语、或对其作出回应的人身上。所以，听众要做的第二件事，
就是补充讲课人假定双方都知道的信息。
records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.decision: 人工逐屏EN/ZH对应审查通过；保留候选边界和中文。

records.en: Now when you listen you need time to think about the information, relate it to old ideas, take notes, and if you’re only keeping up with what I’m saying or what the lecturer’s saying, you have no time to do that.

如果你只是勉强跟上我或讲课人的讲话，就没有时间做这些事了。

records.en: And I’ll bet a lot of you are having that problem right now because it’s so hard just to follow everything I’m saying, that you don’t have time to note down ideas.

因而没有时间记下要点。

records.en: Now let’s come to the last thing a listener must do: the listener must evaluate, as he or she is listening, decide what’s important, what’s not, decide how something relates to something else.

records.en: From what I’ve said so far, you can see there’s a lot involved in listening to lectures: language awareness, adding information, making predictions and evaluations.

records.en: The number from the state schools, who are going to leading universities, has increased over the years, but there is still an issue about ensuring the pupils from our state schools apply to go into the universities, and if you look at the Oxford figures, for example, you see that the percentage of students applying to Oxford from the state schools is about 1%, whereas from the private schools it’s over 4.5%, so that, you know, that’s the problem, it’s expectations in the state system that have been driven down by this Government over the years.
